description: Hot-wallet Verdikta Bounties operator for Base. Creates/imports Ethereum keys, stores encrypted keystore and API key locally, uploads public bounty/work data, calls Verdikta API/Base RPC, and can sign irreversible mainnet/testnet transactions.

shell.purpose: Run local helper scripts and install JavaScript dependencies.

network.notes: Configured Base RPC URLs and Verdikta API URL are read from the skill config; custom endpoints should be reviewed before signing.

read: operator-selected spend policy and approved work-order draft
filesystem.notes: Config is read from exported environment variables and the stable config path only. scripts/.env is intentionally ignored.

transactionTypes: start evaluation with payable ETH prepay

primaryCredential.notes: Credentials read fresh from disk at runtime — never embedded as literals. VERDIKTA_WALLET_PASSWORD decrypts the keystore in-memory only when signing transactions; private keys are never written to disk or logs. API key stored separately at ~/.config/verdikta-bounties/verdikta-bounties-bot.json (chmod 600). Scripts enforce chmod 600 after credential writes. Grant wallet minimal funds only — hot wallet posture.

credentialSetup.description: Run 'node scripts/onboard.js' for guided setup: creates or imports an encrypted wallet keystore, waits for human funding, registers and persists a bot API key. No secrets are hardcoded.

securityNotes: Use a fresh low-balance bot wallet; do not import high-value personal wallets.
Transaction-capable scripts require interactive confirmation or --yes/--confirm-spend.
Bounty metadata, submitted work files, CIDs, wallet addresses, and transaction hashes may become public via IPFS, Verdikta API records, and blockchain state.

Draft handoff executes the sibling verdikta-discover code and locked dependencies in the signing process. Install both from the same reviewed repository revision and protect them from untrusted replacement. Signed recovery state can broadcast the exact approved transaction; keep it private.
